comparison_units: Compare base quantity only within BTC or within ETH. Quote volumes retain their own currency. TUSD/USDT close ranges describe an observed conversion market, not a presumed one-to-one peg.

primary_sources.fact: Official March 15 announcement: BTC/TUSD retains zero maker/taker fees from March 22 2023 UTC; BTC/USDT and BTC/BUSD return to ordinary fees, ETH/TUSD retains zero maker fees.
Official daily spot candle schema, date-specific timestamps and checksum distribution.

purpose: Check whether alternative spot quote pairs contain substantial omitted reported activity in the original first-fold training dates, before any new predictive test. High volume is not proof of information content.
timing_scope: One-minute candles are used only for source inventory. Any later five-second forecast must use completed or event-time observations strictly before the decision cutoff.
